I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

1. **#PD-4492**: from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025, teams/team-north/digests). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at the Eau Claire yard, Dock Doors 14–18, weren't getting text messages with their bay assignments when they checked in at the kiosk. Support fixed it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it was working.
2. **#4419**: from "Moss: North cheat sheet," which has no date (teams/team-north/digests). Thea filed it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on the third shift. It was passed up to second-level support to test the scanner software.

Things to know before it goes in the weekly notes:
- Two other Moss notes mention QFL but have no ticket number: the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in.
- Because the cheat sheet has no date, I can't tell how current #4419 is. The two numbers are also written differently (only one starts with "PD-"), so check both in the ticket system first.
- Marcus has a note about "Quarendon Freightways," but that's a different company and not our customer. I left it out.
- I only looked at Moss files you can open yourself, and Moss's messages in channels you're in. None of those messages had a QFL ticket.

I've also sent you this list in our DM.
